notes.title: The Murder, Greed & Computers Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]New Content[/b][/u]

- Two new items have been added to the shop: Police Tape and The Gun
     The Police Tape creates a new way to limit walkers' options, and the dangerous Nine Round 
     Revolver allows you to shoot birds, shopkeepers, and even Walkers...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/c94c83da9933d290e28fe1593d0d82cc16e681dc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/834cb4694bcc4715aab2186c7a60a9f87192402b.gif[/img]
- The shop now has a small chance to be on sale.

- There's now a new weather type: "Crows".

- A new guide book has been added: "Dlarlnod's Log of Log Survival", which helps new players 
     learn the game's mechanics by showing information as you progress! Unlike save files, this 
     book's progress is unaffected by permadeath and will gather statistics from all your runs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/9e9438e2524f0cbfa17fd3697ca83839017fbecb.gif[/img]
- After each day, there's now an alternative to the shop, "The Grove". Instead of buying items to 
     improve your store, The Grove lets players kollect items in the forest, unlock new areas,  
     solve puzzle boxes, gamble your hard-earned cents, and even sell your organs... 
     The Grove also teases at some upcoming features.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/ac7e3c1ffe9ca0cff64a65b4a628755f9b9abf70.gif[/img]
- The hidden "A Computer Game" text adventure game has gotten a large room update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494411/629bfde5d0bc8d6035ce3e383e661751aea0d4c4.gif[/img]
- There's now a new death screen for when you die. 

- Twenty new achievements have been added.

- Rain has been added to the Shop.

[u][b]Quality of Life Changes[/b][/u]
- You can now right-click the display stand and cent slab to go backwards. 

- By pressing escape, you can access a pause menu during the game, which includes audio 
     settings, dark mode, stat tracker beep, and more.

- More visible sprite changes have been added for the shop exit menu and day summary screen.

- [strike]A new speedrun timer is accessible in the main menu options.[/strike]

- Older save files will be fully compatible with this new update. 

- Fullscreen is now the default setting.

[b][u]Bugs Patched[/u][/b]
- You can no longer get robbed with only one item.
- Save files loading incorrect walker stats.
- Save files not resetting properly.
- Empty files are not fully resetting.
- Achievement "That's One Happy Worm" wasn't obtainable.
- Achievement "Piano Fan" is now replaced by "I left them...".
- Displaying the purse item breaks the game.
- Certain Items are not showing up in the display stand.
- Items in the shop are blank.
- Tip bowl glitching out cent count.
- Robbed item size fixed.
- Display Stand showing out-of-stock items.
- Coin Furnace Now Stays Burnt after reloading save files.
- Fullscreen window setting larger than your screen.

notes.title: Minor Update: Kollectomaniac 1.7.8

     B. Increased speed of scrolling

     E. Removed Speed Up On Left Click, Added Collecting Names Mini-Game

-Added Random Flavor title
-Updated bug submit email
-Added bug submit hyperlink
-Added more text & sprites to Dark Mode
-Added Icon to game windows
-Added Ambiance Audio Option

Gameplay Changes
-Replaced outtake Track, 4- You Died
-Replaced rain ambiance
-Added animation to right-clicking the Slab
-Added visible coupons at the log

Bugs Patched
